extDescription: Control HTML5 video playback speed from the Chrome toolbar. Open source. No accounts, analytics, or servers.
popupUnavailable: OS VSC isn’t available on this page
broaderAccessNotice: All-sites access is still enabled. Turn off “Enable on all sites” in Settings, or change this extension’s Site access in Chrome.
enableOnAllSitesDescription: Automatically make Video Speed Controller available on every website, without enabling sites one at a time.
allSitesAccessAlertDescription: Chrome may ask for permission to read and change data on all websites. This permission allows Video Speed Controller to detect and control videos automatically on the pages you visit. The extension does not collect page data or send extension traffic to a server. All-site access is optional and can be revoked at any time.
allSitesAccessSwitchDescription: Applies only to this browser profile. This permission is not synced.
allSitesAccessError: Could not update site access. Try again, or change this extension’s Site access in Chrome.
settingsDefaultsDescription: Sites use these values until you change them.
settingsSiteDescription: Overrides global defaults for this site.
speedTickDescription: Amount Faster and Slower change the speed. 0.0005× to 1.00×.
overlayPositionDescription: Where overlay controls appear on videos.
overlayPositionButtonDescription: Show a button on the overlay for changing its position.
overlaySettingsButtonDescription: Show a button on the overlay that opens settings.
overlayHoverHoldDescription: Keep overlay controls visible while the pointer is over them.
overlayAutoHideDelayDescription: Seconds of inactivity before the overlay hides. 0.1s to 300s.
resetAllConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove all of your settings? You will not be able to undo this decision.
exportSettingsDescription: Download your settings as a JSON file.
importSettingsDescription: Restore settings from a backup file.
importMergeConfirm: Import these settings? Matching settings will be overwritten. Other settings stay as they are.
importReplaceConfirm: Replace all settings with this backup? Site overrides not in the file will be removed. You will not be able to undo this decision.
backupInvalid: This file is not a valid Video Speed Controller backup.
backupTooLarge: This backup file is too large.
backupTooManySites: This backup contains too many sites.
backupNewerVersion: This backup was created by a newer version of Video Speed Controller.
backupNewerSettings: This backup contains settings added by a newer version of Video Speed Controller.
deleteSiteConfirm: Remove settings for this site? You will not be able to undo this decision.
settingsNewerVersion: Settings were created by a newer version.
settingsResetPartial: Some settings were created by a newer version and were left unchanged.
settingsRefreshError: Saved, but settings could not be refreshed.
settingsReapplyError: Saved, but open tabs could not be refreshed.
